correctness.rationale: Exact scalar Gaussian conditioning gives the risk; strict concavity of the covariance potential and reflection prove global endpoint anchoring; a monotone stationary equation gives the unique sub-half-length gap. A standalone deterministic script passed 20666 supplementary checks; finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Differential-only sensing is a natural restricted information channel in gradient/relative measurement. The exact global theorem states that one endpoint must be used, the second must be before the midpoint, and the maximum-separation contrast is entirely uninformative for the integral. It supplies a unique noise-calibrated gap and a complete long-correlation scaling curve from one-third to one-half. These are actionable geometric design boundaries, not merely a covariance rewrite or arbitrary tabulated case.
